title: AKOS reviewer agent frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter block of agents/*.md only. The prose body (Purpose, When to use, Packs to load, Review checklist, Severity levels, Scoring rubric, Refusal/limits, Output format) is meant for an LLM to read and reason over, not data to be schema-validated — that's checked separately, as a section-heading presence count (same technique doctor.sh already uses for SKILL.md frontmatter), not via this schema. schema_version 1 is the versioned, strict contract: additionalProperties is false, so an unknown top-level key is an error. All 13 agents carry schema_version: 1.

schema_version.description: Which version of this contract the file was authored against. An unknown value must fail explicitly, never fall back to the current schema.

tools.description: A comma-joined string, e.g. 'Read, Grep, Glob' — confirmed the real format across all 13 agents, NOT a YAML list.

id.description: Optional. Default: the pipeline-lens number this agent owns, e.g. 'lens-2'.
